title: anemone alpina var. apiifolia
intro: Anemone alpina var. apiifolia, commonly known as the alpine anemone, is a flowering plant that belongs to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It is native to mountainous regions in Europe and Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The plant is valued for its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which provide therapeutic actions such as wound healing and pain relief. Bioactive constituents of the alpine anemone include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
